definitions.candidate_outcomes: Mutually exclusive categories on the single dev evaluation per model candidate: correct_above_c0 = correct and score > c0; correct_not_above_c0 = correct and score <= c0; failed = incorrect or execution failure.
definitions.duplicate_code_occurrences: Within each reported group, model-generated candidate count minus unique exact code SHA256 count. c0 excluded from the set; same_as_c0 counted separately.
definitions.first_improvement: First correct model candidate strictly above dev c0, using validation-ended timestamp minus episode-start; no statistical threshold.
definitions.action_counts: All steps with actor=model; includes invalid actions, API error steps, and finish. These are recorded events, not distinct HTTP requests.
definitions.latency: Usage ledger latency per role/purpose; generation includes analyze and finish as well as code proposals.
definitions.sources: Subset of the archived desktop report inputs already fingerprinted in analysis.json. Mac reports excluded.
